scenes.title: AVG
scenes.narration: AVG computes the mean of a numeric column, giving you a quick sense of central tendency.

scenes.title: Averaging values
bullets: Divides the sum by the count
scenes.narration: AVG works by dividing the total of the values by how many there are. It excludes NULLs from both the sum and the count, so they never skew the mean. Grouped by a category, it reveals the typical value within each segment.

scenes.title: Average salary by department
scenes.narration: GROUP BY splits employees into one group per department. AVG then computes the mean salary for each of those groups. The alias avg_salary names the result so the output is easy to interpret.

scenes.heading: AVG vs SUM/COUNT
scenes.narration: AVG expresses the mean directly and handles NULL exclusion for you. Dividing SUM by COUNT by hand can produce the same number but is easy to get wrong. Because AVG already ignores NULLs consistently, it is both clearer and safer.

scenes.text: AVG gives a NULL-safe mean in one step, so prefer it over manual division.
scenes.narration: Reach for AVG to compute a mean, since it correctly ignores NULLs and reads more clearly than dividing SUM by COUNT yourself.
